id.name: Scan QRIS
steps: Buka aplikasi yang mendukung pembayaran dengan QRIS.
Download atau pindai QRIS pada layar.

en.name: Scan QRIS
steps: Open an app that supports QRIS payments.
Download or scan the QRIS on the screen.
Confirm the payment on the app.

id.name: ATM BCA
steps: Pilih transaksi lainnya pada menu utama.
Pilih ke rekening BCA virtual account.
Masukkan jumlah yang akan dibayar, lalu konfirmasi.

id.name: Klik BCA
steps: Pilih Transfer ke BCA virtual account.
Masukkan jumlah yang akan dibayar, lalu konfirmasi.

id.name: m-BCA
steps: Masukkan jumlah yang akan dibayar, lalu konfirmasi.

en.name: ATM BCA
steps: Select other transactions on the main menu.
Enter the BCA virtual account number.
Enter the amount to be paid, then confirm.

en.name: Klik BCA
steps: Select Transfer to BCA virtual account.
Enter the BCA virtual account number.
Enter the amount to be paid, then confirm.

en.name: m-BCA
steps: Enter the BCA virtual account number.
Enter the amount to be paid, then confirm.

id.name: Livin' by Mandiri
steps: Pilih Midtrans di bagian penyedia jasa.
Masukkan nomor virtual account pada bagian kode bayar.

id.name: Mandiri Internet Banking
steps: Pilih Midtrans di bagian penyedia jasa.

en.name: Livin' by Mandiri
steps: Select pay on the main menu.
Select Midtrans in the service provider section.
Enter the virtual account number in the payment code section.

en.name: ATM Mandiri
steps: Select pay/buy on the main menu.
Enter the payment code, then confirm.

en.name: Mandiri Internet Banking
steps: Select pay on the main menu.
Select Midtrans in the service provider section.
Enter the payment code, then confirm.

id.name: ATM BNI
steps: Pilih menu lain pada menu utama.
Masukkan jumlah yang akan dibayar, lalu konfirmasi.

id.name: Internet Banking
steps: Pilih transaksi, lalu info & administrasi transfer.
Pilih transfer, lalu transfer ke rekening BNI.

id.name: Mobile Banking
steps: Pilih rekening debit yang akan digunakan.
Masukkan nomor virtual account, lalu konfirmasi.

en.name: BNI ATM
steps: Select other menu on the main menu.
Enter the amount to be paid, then confirm.

en.name: Internet Banking
steps: Select transaction, then transfer info & administration.
Select transfer, then transfer to BNI account.

en.name: Mobile Banking
steps: Select the debit account to be used.
Enter the virtual account number, then confirm.

id.name: ATM BRI
steps: Pilih transaksi lainnya pada menu utama.

en.name: BRI ATM
steps: Select other transactions on the main menu.
Enter the BRIVA number, then confirm.

en.name: Internet Banking BRI
steps: Enter the BRIVA number, then confirm.

en.name: BRImo
steps: Enter the BRIVA number, then confirm.

id.name: ATM Permata/ALTO
steps: Pilih transaksi lainnya pada menu utama.
Masukkan nomor virtual account Permata, lalu konfirmasi.

en.name: Permata/ALTO ATM
steps: Select other transactions on the main menu.
Enter the Permata virtual account number, then confirm.

id.name: ATM CIMB Niaga
steps: Masukkan nomor virtual account, lalu konfirmasi.

id.name: OCTO Clicks
steps: Pilih pembayaran tagihan pada menu utama.
Masukkan nomor virtual account, lalu klik lanjut untuk verifikasi detail.
Masukkan OTP yang dikirimkan ke nomor HP Anda, lalu konfirmasi.

id.name: OCTO Mobile
steps: Pilih transfer to other CIMB Niaga account.
Pilih sumber dana: CASA atau rekening ponsel.

en.name: CIMB Niaga ATM
steps: Select payment on the main menu.
Enter the virtual account number, then confirm.

en.name: OCTO Clicks
steps: Select bill payment on the main menu.
Enter the virtual account number, then click continue to verify details.
Enter the OTP sent to your mobile number, then confirm.

en.name: OCTO Mobile
steps: Select transfer to other CIMB Niaga account.
Select source of funds: CASA or mobile account.
Enter the amount to be paid.
Follow the instructions to complete the payment.

id.name: Transfer Bank
steps: Pilih transfer antar bank atau transfer ke bank lain.
Pilih Bank BNI atau masukkan 009 sebagai kode bank.

en.name: Bank Transfer
steps: Select transfer to other bank accounts.
Select Bank BNI or enter 009 as the bank code.
Enter the amount to be paid.
